paragraphs.text: Hi! My name is Amina, and I study business and administration with a specialisation in marketing at Molde University College. The internship at Molde Sykkel is exactly the kind of digital marketing I want to learn more about, and I would love to apply.
paragraphs.rationale: A friendly, informal opening that fits the tone you chose and names your field of study straight away.
linkedRequirements: Studies marketing, business or a similar field

paragraphs.text: For the past year I have run the Instagram account for the Kult Student Society. I plan and create the posts myself, and in one semester we grew our followers by 40%. I have learned what actually makes people stop and read, and I would like to bring that to you.
paragraphs.rationale: This is your strongest evidence. A concrete number is more convincing than saying you are creative.
linkedRequirements: Experience creating content for social media

paragraphs.text: From two years at XXL Molde I know both bikes and the customers who buy them, and I have run campaigns in-store. I haven't worked with paid advertising or video editing yet, and that is exactly what I hope to learn during the internship.
paragraphs.rationale: Connects your retail experience to the industry and to campaign work, and is honest about the gaps instead of hiding them. That suits an internship, where learning is the point.
linkedRequirements: Have experience from retail or customer service
Interest in cycling and outdoor life
Experience with Google Ads or Meta advertising
Can edit video, for example in CapCut or Premiere Pro

paragraphs.text: I can work 50% throughout the spring and would be happy to drop by for a chat. Thank you so much for reading my application!
paragraphs.rationale: Confirms you can work the percentage the posting asks for, and closes in the same friendly tone.
